plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample 4-year course plan ('Bachelor of Arts in Physics and Astronomy') from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Physics and Astronomy program PDF (12 quarters). VARIABLE-CREDIT RECONCILIATION: the bulletin lists MATH 2070 as 0-4 credits and declares 'Total Credits: 183-187'. Across the 0-4 range the bulletin's own grid sums to 182-186, one credit below its declared range (a bulletin arithmetic inconsistency, documented here — no invented credits added). MATH 2070 is encoded at 4 (the full course value), which reconciles the Second Year Winter term total to the bulletin's stated 14 and yields a degree total of 186, inside the bulletin's declared 183-187. Declared total 186 = plan's actual sum; term totals (Y1 14/17/17, Y2 17/14/17, Y3 16/16/16, Y4 14/16/12) reconcile exactly. Generic slots (language sequences, AI/SI requirements, PHYS electives, minor/elective blocks, ASEM, study-abroad block) encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them; no courses invented. Footnote 1: Analytical Inquiry-Society and Scientific Inquiry-Society courses may be taken in any order. Footnote 2: PHYS 3510 Analytical Mechanics I and PHYS 3611 Electromagnetism I are offered every other year; PHYS 3111 Quantum Physics I and PHYS 3841 Thermal Physics in the alternating years; either set may be taken first. Footnote 3: recommended electives include PHYS 2311, PHYS 3112, PHYS 3520, PHYS 3612; BA students may also enroll in any elective PHYS course and in variable-credit PHYS 3991/PHYS 3995; graduate-level courses may count with permission. Third Year Fall is the bulletin's recommended study-abroad quarter.
